expectations.text: Recommends extracting the shared Avatar component (NOT keeping 12 inline copies)
expectations.evidence: 'Extract the <Avatar/> component.' and bottom line 'extract it. The shared-component camp is right.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the pure-presentation / understood-in-isolation test (low external context to consume)
expectations.evidence: 'Keep it a pure presentational component — no data fetching, no context coupling — so it stays trivial to drop in anywhere.' Distinguishes 'self-contained via copy-paste' from a genuinely isolatable component.

expectations.text: Rejects the 'keep inline for self-containment' argument as misapplied to a reusable primitive
expectations.evidence: 'Locality of behaviour beats DRY is a real... heuristic... it's the right call for trivial, incidental duplication. A 50-line block... copied 12 times, is neither trivial nor incidental. It's a real component wearing a disguise.' 'The senior is conflating two different things.'

expectations.text: Frames the shared component as a real abstraction (read at call site without opening internals), not just DRY
expectations.evidence: 'The honest, legible version of this component uses an avatar is import { Avatar }... Name it discoverably... so an assistant finds it by convention' — a tight prop API as a contract, framed beyond mere deduplication.
